rules.description: task tool tracking: list created at task start, status kept current (concept 51; defect 4 F6)
stock: Use ${TASK_TOOL_NAMES} to plan and track work. Mark each task completed as soon as it's done; don't batch.
unnerf: Use ${TASK_TOOL_NAMES} to plan and track work. Create the list at the start of any multi-step task. Mark a task in_progress before you start it. Mark it completed as soon as it is done. Do not batch completions.
